name: Cash Couriers and Bulk Cash Smuggling
description: Physical movement of banknotes across borders or within a country, by couriers, vehicles, freight, mail or hidden in goods, to place proceeds in or move them to jurisdictions with weak controls. Flows may reappear as deposits, exchange house transactions or trade.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering through the Physical Transportation of Cash (2015)
FATF, International Best Practices: Detecting and Preventing the Illicit Cross-Border Transportation of Cash and Bearer Negotiable Instruments (2010)
FATF, Interpretive Note to Recommendation 32 (Cash Couriers), in The FATF Recommendations (2012, as amended)

exposure.rationale: Physical cash placed via deposits and exchange houses; trade fronts.
